Class MainWindow

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
be.henallux.project.view.MainWindow
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants
public class MainWindow extends JFrame
This class acts as the central frame of the application.

It provides the main window structure and manages navigation between all application views using a CardLayout. Each screen (home, tables, forms, detail views) is registered under a unique identifier and can be displayed on demand.

The navigation system is complemented by a history stack allowing basic back navigation.

This frame also exposes high-level navigation methods used by views and controllers to open specific forms or detail screens such as DocumentForm or ClientSupplierForm.

It integrates the JMenuBar implementation via MenuWindow and acts as the central entry point for user interactions in the Swing application.

    • openDocumentForm

      public void openDocumentForm(Document doc)
      Opens the document form in creation or edition mode depending on the provided document.

      If doc is null, the form is initialized in creation mode. Otherwise, the form is populated with the given Document for editing.

      Parameters:
      doc - the Document to edit, or null to create a new document
      See Also:
      • DocumentForm.loadDocument(Document)

    • openClientSupplierForm

      public void openClientSupplierForm(ClientSupplier cs)
      Opens the client/supplier form in creation or edition mode.

      If the provided ClientSupplier is null, the form is reset to creation mode. Otherwise, the form is populated with the selected entity for modification.

      Parameters:
      cs - the ClientSupplier to edit, or null for creation mode

    • openOrderView

      public void openOrderView(ArrayList<Product> selectedProduct, ClientSupplier selectedSupplier)
      Opens the stock order creation view with a predefined selection.

      The view is initialized using a list of selected Product items and an optional supplier ClientSupplier, allowing the user to prepare a stock order.

      Parameters:
      selectedProduct - the list of products included in the order
      selectedSupplier - the supplier associated with the order
      See Also:
      • StockOrderCreation.loadOrder(ArrayList, ClientSupplier)
